name: badonion-data
description: Read-only access to BadOnion (나쁜양파) data: monthly trade statistics by HS code for 26 economies, company financials, producer price indices, Japan and Taiwan monthly sales, supply-chain prices, corporate credit spreads and AI lab revenue estimates.

interface.longDescription:
BadOnion (나쁜양파) is a Korean data service for investors who follow the real economy. This plugin connects ChatGPT to the same data shown on badonion.co.kr, through 43 read-only tools.

What you can ask about:
- Trade statistics: monthly exports and imports by HS code for 26 economies (Korea, US, China, Japan, Taiwan, EU members and more), country-by-partner breakdowns, Korea's preliminary figures (released on the 1st, 11th and 21st of each month), and Korea's market share in major import markets.
- Company financials: quarterly and annual income statements, revenue by product and region, financial summaries in USD, and earnings estimates for US, Korean, Japanese, Chinese and Hong Kong listed companies.
- Company-linked trade data: curated export and import series linked to listed companies, with year-over-year changes and month-end stock prices, plus screens that rank all linked companies or all trade codes by recent growth.
- Charts: trade and company-linked series can be shown as interactive charts inside the conversation, drawn the same way as on the website.
- Prices: producer price indices for the US, Japan, Korea, China and the EU; supply-chain inventories, lead times and selling prices (GPU rental, CPU, memory and more).
- Monthly sales: Japanese listed companies' monthly sales releases and Taiwan monthly revenue.
- Credit: bond spreads, yields and implied default probabilities for big tech, AI infrastructure, semiconductor and power companies.
- AI revenue tracker: weekly estimates of leading AI labs' annualized revenue compared with their official figures, and each lab's share of business AI spending.
- Research posts published on BadOnion.

How it works: sign in with your BadOnion account when you connect (OAuth). All tools only read data. They never modify your account or any external system.

나쁜양파(BadOnion)의 무역통계·기업 재무·생산자물가·월매출·공급망·크레딧·AI 매출 추정 데이터를 ChatGPT 에서 조회합니다. 연결할 때 나쁜양파 계정으로 로그인합니다. 모든 도구는 읽기 전용입니다.
